configuration.data:
kind: AdaptiveDialog
beginDialog:
  kind: OnEventActivity
  id: main
  priority: 1000
  eventName: Microsoft.PowerApps.Copilot.CopilotFeatures
  actions:
    - kind: SetVariable
      id: setVariable_u38uyQ
      variable: Global.PA_Copilot_Features
      value: |-
        ={ CustomVersion: Global.PA_Copilot_Custom_Version,
          PlatformVersion: Global.PA_Copilot_Features.PlatformVersion,
          Features: Global.PA_Copilot_Features.Features
         }

    - kind: SendActivity
      id: sendActivity_E0IBE8
      activity:
        kind: EventActivity
        value: =Global.PA_Copilot_Features
        name: "=\"MS.PA.CopilotFeatures\""
configuration.description: Sends the Copilot Bot Version and Features to the Copilot Client Runtime
configuration.name: Copilot Bot Features - Event Trigger - Response to Copilot
